startup.failed: The app couldn’t start. Try again in a moment.

error.body: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

offline.title: No signal
offline.body: Check your connection and try again.

phone.title: Sign in with your mobile number
phone.body: Use the number the store invited. We’ll text you a code.
phone.invalid: Enter your mobile number with its country code.

code.title: Enter the code
code.label: 6-digit code
code.resent: A new code is on its way.

profile.title: Profile
profile.setupBody: {name} and its customers see this while you’re delivering their order.
profile.setupBodyUnnamed: The store and its customers see this while you’re delivering their order.
profile.name: Your name
profile.nameRequired: Add your name so the store and customers know who’s coming.

photo.cameraDenied: Camera access is off. Allow it in Settings, or choose a photo from your library.

profile.vehicleNumberHint: As on the number plate. Customers see it so they know it’s you.

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.body: You’ll be signed out and can’t take deliveries for this store. Any delivery you’ve accepted goes back to other delivery partners. Past deliveries show “Former delivery partner” instead of your name.
delete.refusedTitle: You can’t delete your account yet
delete.refusedBody: Deliver or return your current parcel first.

errors.NO_RESPONSE: No signal. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Something here isn’t valid. Check it and try again.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.CODE_REFUSED: That code didn’t work. Check it, or ask the store to invite this number.
errors.RIDER_SUSPENDED: The store has paused your account. Ask the store to restore it.
errors.STORE_UNAVAILABLE: The store isn’t available right now. Try again later.
errors.UNAVAILABLE: The store isn’t available right now. Try again later.
errors.PHOTO_NOT_FOUND: Upload the photo again, then save.
errors.TOO_LARGE: That photo is too large. Choose a smaller one.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_TYPE: That file isn’t a photo we can use. Choose a JPEG or PNG.
errors.EMPTY: That photo is empty. Choose another one.

signIn.RATE_LIMITED: Too many tries. Wait 10 minutes, then ask for a new code.
signIn.INVALID_INPUT: Enter your mobile number with its country code.

signOut.RIDER_HAS_PARCEL: You can’t sign out while you’re carrying a parcel. Deliver or return it first.

deleteAccount.RIDER_HAS_PARCEL: Deliver or return your current parcel first.

permissions.locationAlways: {name} shares your position with the store while you are Online, so it can see where your deliveries are, even when the app is closed.
permissions.locationWhenInUse: {name} uses your position to show you nearby deliveries.
permissions.photos: Choose a profile photo from your photo library for {name}.
